principles.feeling: A calm workbench for turning intent into proven work. The project, next outcome and evidence carry the interface.
rules: One clear next action per view.
Remove repeated explanations and decorative containers.
Keep agent work inspectable by people.
Accepted evidence must describe the current checkout.

brand.idea: A checkmark above a bowl: the work has been tried, not merely described.
brand.clearSpace: Keep at least one quarter of the tile width clear around the mark.
dont: Stretch the tile or redraw the checkmark.
Use the logo gradient as a page background.
Replace real status with the brand mark.

colorsDark.name: Blue
colorsDark.role: Links and actions; filled buttons use darker blue

fonts.name: System sans (SF Pro on macOS)
fonts.use: UI, headings and readable project documents

fonts.name: System mono
fonts.use: Commands, paths and exact machine output

rules: Use scale and whitespace before extra color.
Keep reading paragraphs near 65 characters per line.
Allow long outcomes and evidence to wrap.

components.name: Navigation
components.rule: Project picker, section list, then searchable page evidence. Preserve native controls.

components.name: Project selector
components.rule: One chevron 12px inside the right edge. Reserve text padding; never layer a native arrow with a custom arrow.

components.name: Work list
components.rule: Short outcome rows beside the selected task and its receipt; selected detail leads on phones.

components.name: Page report
components.rule: Computer and phone captures, then six plain answers; open detail to inspect evidence.

components.name: Forms
components.rule: Visible labels, one Save action, clear Cancel and errors; optional settings stay behind a disclosure.

components.name: Documents
components.rule: Readable text and a real sandboxed brand guide with a full-page escape.

avoid: Implementation names in human empty states

examples.text: Track the work and the checks that prove it is done.
The checkout changed. Run the checks again before accepting.

imagery.direction: Real project screenshots are the primary imagery.
rules: Keep captures honest about device and age.
dont: Stock photos, decorative AI imagery or fake browser content.

icons.style: Small consistent line icons for navigation; shaped status marks communicate state.
dont: Decorative icon bubbles or duplicated dropdown arrows.

principles: Use only restrained feedback and native disclosure behavior.
motion.reduceMotion: Remove nonessential transitions when reduced motion is requested.

accessibility: WCAG AA text contrast in both themes.
Visible keyboard focus and complete keyboard paths.
Every control has an accessible name; form errors explain recovery.
Test at 1280 and 390 wide with substantive content.
Status uses a word or shape as well as color.
